correctness.rationale: Each n=3..32 has complete lexicographic vertex partition into pairwise-confusable cliques and an equally large independent code. Direct descendant-set verifier checks every upper/lower certificate; finite equalities follow by sandwich; pairwise graph model reconstructs exact two-distinct-read semantics. Scope is explicitly finite.

evidence: Weight-two two-read capacity equals floor(n^2/4), in a different weight layer. Unrestricted q-ary results for length three and four do not determine fixed-weight-three n>=5. The general 2020 theorem supplies asymptotic constructions rather than this finite exact census.

evidence: One-read-correcting codes are also two-read-correcting, providing lower bounds but not these two-read optima. Known two-read edge/triangle counts and weight-two capacity do not yield the weight-three independence size.

evidence: Standard two-read deletion reconstruction is independence in the graph joining pairs with at least two distinct common one-deletion outputs; no inspected foundational statement fixes Hamming weight exactly three and gives the complete exact finite capacities.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Intersecting the unrestricted graph with the weight-three layer changes its independence number. The certificate results cannot be extracted by merely substituting weight three into the general redundancy bounds.
